notes: Kernel Holding S.A. (KER.WA) — largest sunflower oil producer/exporter in Ukraine, listed on Warsaw Stock Exchange (WSE). Reports in USD; lists in PLN. Fiscal year ends June 30 (FY24 = year ended 30 Jun 2024). Operating segments: Oilseed Processing (sunflower meal/oil), Infrastructure & Trading (silo network + grain export), Farming (~370k ha leased Ukrainian cropland). FY22-FY23 results materially affected by Russia's invasion of Ukraine (port closures, Black Sea grain corridor disruption). Annual reports: kernel.ua/en/financial-reports/. Public-tender delisting offer pending.

periods.notes: FY21 record EBITDA $930M on strong sunflower oil prices and bumper harvest.
FY22 disrupted by Russian invasion (Feb 2022). Impairments on Russian-occupied assets. EBITDA halved YoY.
FY23 revenue down sharply on lower volumes (Black Sea corridor uncertainty). EBITDA recovered to $444M.
FY24 revenue $3.5B, EBITDA $519M. Net debt down to $683M as ops normalized via Ukraine maritime corridor.
